Identity: codex-storymodel-collab. INDEPENDENT DELTA REVIEW of exact clean c4ed30e89e1cecd0537719c3471b73084b63f9b4.

B2 ACCEPT. Diff is exactly the two reserved files. The guard now validates the dimensionless quotient, clamps the inclusive 1 + 1e-9 boundary to stored Observed(1.0), rejects 1 + 2e-9, and rejects the tiny-denominator absolute-tolerance exploit. Independent focused SignatureSuite gate: 1/1 green.

B1 CONFIRMED STILL LIVE. Independent focused FeaturesIntegrationSuite public-path test: 1/1 green only because it intercepts IllegalArgumentException from RecallSignature.compute on Estimate.observed(Double.NaN). The B2 delta does not touch that path.

ONE STRONGER REACHABILITY RESULT FOR THE DEFERRED RULING: the separately ruled upstream boundary is finite + nonnegative per leaf. That alone cannot make compute total. Two individually lawful Double.MaxValue importances make observedWeights.sum infinite; WeightedCoverage.of correctly returns Left because conditioningWeight is not finite, and compute still folds that refusal into the public throw. The same can happen to the weighted numerator. Therefore the fold remains reachable even after the stated upstream P1 unless that contract also imposes an aggregate-safe upper bound or the aggregation changes representation. The typed Either channel is not merely accommodation for the current NaN hole.

Verdict: c4ed30e closes B2; candidate remains HOLD only on B1 pending the chief return-type ruling. No edits or reservations from me.
